name: ComingSoon
description: A branded, single-page “Coming Soon” landing that a freshly provisioned site serves from the moment DNS resolves until the real site is published. Not a theme and not a site builder — one skinnable holding page, zero-config beyond a preset skin, that turns off automatically the instant a real theme goes live.
_notes: PUBLIC / BSD-3. The repository ROOT is the module: on install its contents land in application/modules/comingsoon/. While ACTIVE it owns the public home ('/') via a front-controller plugin (Bootstrap) and renders one skinned holding page; every other route (login, admin) is untouched. It DEACTIVATES itself the instant a site theme is published (first real public page) — clean swap, no migration. Skins are self-contained CSS-variable overlays (assets/skins/<name>.css) with a catalog entry (configs/skins/<name>.php); adding a skin = adding those two files, no template change. Reads its content (site name, tagline, contact, social) from the install's existing Site Identity config — zero extra input beyond skin selection. No external CDN; fonts are system stacks; target Lighthouse 95+. Bundled with TigerInstall as the default fresh-install landing and auto-activated by TigerServer on account creation.
